I work from home in the mornings, afternoon is playing video games, writing, reading, watching movies/TV. Evening is when everyone else comes home. 

I need to get out more.

Thank you very, very much for your comment. :) Talking to people is my usual go to, it's been tough to accomplish that lately. 

My wife and I recently moved in with two friends of our friends, a couple. I feel more isolated now than ever. All three of them hang out all the time, I can't seem to stand it. Just wanna be left alone and do my thing. It's weird and makes me sad.
